name: Zajchik: Istorija Kati
source:
Here, the story unfolds from Smirnova's perspective. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of lost serenity and the struggle to adapt to a new reality, alongside the Grade 6-B Class President.

Which path will you guide the heroine down? Featuring an original plot and a detailed story of the making of the most popular girl in class.
